overview.title: A campus among the pines
overview.p1: Al Akhawayn University is part of Ifrane's modern identity: a planned campus, mountain views, and a different feel from traditional historic cities. Visitors usually stay in public outdoor areas.
overview.p2: Do not disrupt classes. For most travelers, it is a brief architectural stop rather than a museum visit.

q1.question: Can I take an interior tour?
q1.answer: Generally there is no official tourist tour — exterior viewing only.

q2.question: Why visit?
q2.answer: For the architecture and contrast with traditional Moroccan cities.

q3.question: Is it open every day?
q3.answer: The campus runs on an academic schedule; outer roads vary.

q4.question: Is it far from the centre?
q4.answer: On the edge of Ifrane — a short taxi or walk depending on your hotel.

q5.question: Is English spoken?
q5.answer: The university is known for English-language programs; town services vary.
